## Data

```{r input-workbook}
if (nzchar(params$input_file)) {
  input <- normalizePath(path.expand(params$input_file), mustWork = TRUE)
  input_source <- input
} else {
  input <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")
  input_source <- params$input_url
  status <- download.file(input_source, input, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  stopifnot(status == 0L)
}

input_md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(input))
write_csv(
  data.frame(Input_source = input_source, MD5 = input_md5),
  "Input_provenance.csv"
)
```

```{r read-harvest-sheet}
raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  input, sheet = "2026", range = readxl::cell_cols("A:J"),
  col_types = c("date", rep("numeric", 4), "text", "text", "numeric", "numeric", "date")
)

headers <- c(
  "Biomass collection date", "Weeks after transplanting", "Block", "Treatment",
  "Quadrat", "Relative location to Broccoli: in row or in cover crop", "Species",
  "Biomass weight without bags, scale tared (gram)", "Quadrat size (m2)", "Weight date"
)
if (!identical(names(raw), headers)) {
  stop("Harvest sheet headers differ from the expected A:J layout.")
}

names(raw) <- c(
  "Collection_date", "Weeks_after_transplanting", "Block", "Treatment",
  "Quadrat", "Location_original", "Species_original",
  "Biomass_g", "Area_original_m2", "Weighing_date"
)

records <- mutate(raw, Excel_row = row_number() + 1L)[rowSums(!is.na(raw)) > 0, ]

stopifnot(
  nrow(records) > 0,
  all(is.finite(records$Biomass_g)), all(records$Biomass_g >= 0),
  all(records$Block %in% 1:4), all(records$Treatment %in% 1:4),
  all(records$Quadrat %in% 1:4)
)

if (anyDuplicated(select(records, -Excel_row))) {
  stop("Check exact duplicates among the ten worksheet columns.")
}

excluded <- mutate(records[FALSE, ], Reason = character())
write_csv(excluded, "Excluded_record.csv")
```

```{r sampling-protocol}
field <- records %>%
  mutate(
    Collection_date = as.Date(Collection_date),
    Weighing_date = as.Date(Weighing_date),
    Block = factor(paste0("B", Block), levels = paste0("B", 1:4)),
    Treatment = factor(paste0("T", Treatment), levels = paste0("T", 1:4)),
    Location = if_else(Treatment == "T1", "Weedy check", trimws(Location_original)),
    Stratum = if_else(Location == "Broccoli", "Broccoli", "Cover_crop"),
    Area_m2 = if_else(Stratum == "Broccoli", 0.28, 0.16),
    Cutting_height_cm = if_else(Stratum == "Broccoli", 0, 8),
    Species = sub(
      "^UNKNOWNN ", "UNKNOWN ",
      toupper(trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", Species_original)))
    ),
    Sample_ID = paste(Block, Treatment, Stratum, paste0("Q", Quadrat), sep = "_")
  )

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(field$Collection_date), !anyNA(field$Species),
  all(nzchar(field$Species)),
  all(field$Location[field$Treatment != "T1"] %in% c("Broccoli", "Cover crop"))
)
```

```{r combine-unknown-monocot-weighings}
weighed <- mutate(field, Source_biomass_g = Biomass_g)

target <- which(with(
  weighed,
  Collection_date == as.Date("2026-09-11") &
    Sample_ID == "B4_T4_Cover_crop_Q2" &
    Species == "UNKNOWN MONOCOTS"
))

portions <- c(0.07, 1.34)
observed <- weighed$Source_biomass_g[target]

if (length(observed) == 1L && any(near(observed, c(portions, sum(portions))))) {
  weighed$Biomass_g[target] <- sum(portions)
} else if (!(length(observed) == 2L && all(near(sort(observed), portions)))) {
  stop("Check the two unknown-monocot weighings for B4 T4 interrow quadrat 2.")
}

write_csv(
  select(
    weighed[target, ], Excel_row, Sample_ID, Species, Collection_date,
    Weighing_date, Source_biomass_g, Biomass_g
  ),
  "Split_weighing_audit.csv"
)
```

### Biological categories and taxonomic uncertainty

The primary analysis includes identified weed codes and unidentified groups so that all measured weed dry mass contributes to composition. The identified-code sensitivity analysis quantifies how the treatment results depend on those unresolved groups. Volunteer clover and sown cover crops are summarized separately.

```{r classify-records}
sown <- c(
  "TRFAL", "BERSEEM", "BERSEEM CLOVER", "TRIFOLIUM ALEXANDRINUM",
  "RYE", "CEREAL RYE", "SECCE", "SECALE CEREALE"
)

weed_codes <- c(
  "AMARE", "ARTVU", "CAPBP", "CHEAL", "DIGIS", "DIGSA", "ECHCG",
  "GASCI", "LACSE", "MALNE", "MEDLU", "OXASD", "OXAST", "PLANA",
  "POLLA", "POLPE", "POROL", "SETSP", "SETPU", "SETVI", "TRFRE"
)

clean <- weighed %>%
  mutate(
    Broad_category = case_when(
      Species %in% c("CLOVER", "VOLUNTEER CLOVER") ~ "Volunteer",
      Species %in% sown ~ "Cover crop",
      Species %in% weed_codes | grepl("^UNKNOWN($| )", Species) ~ "Weed",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Identification_status = case_when(
      grepl("^UNKNOWN($| )", Species) ~ "Unidentified weed group",
      Broad_category == "Volunteer" ~ "Unresolved volunteer identity",
      TRUE ~ "Recorded taxon code"
    ),
    Include_primary = Broad_category == "Weed",
    Include_sensitivity = Include_primary & Identification_status == "Recorded taxon code",
    Biomass_g_m2 = Biomass_g / Area_m2
  )

if (anyNA(clean$Broad_category)) {
  stop(
    "Classify new species codes: ",
    paste(unique(clean$Species[is.na(clean$Broad_category)]), collapse = ", ")
  )
}
```


## Quadrat-level indices and independent plot means

| Parameter | Why it was chosen for these harvest samples | Reference |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Dry biomass share, \(p_i=b_i/\sum b_i\) | A label's dry mass divided by the quadrat's included weed dry mass measures its contribution to standing biomass. The field measurements support weighting by dry mass. | Nguyen & Liebman (2022) |
| Recorded richness, \(S\) | Counts positive-mass weed labels once per quadrat, giving a low-biomass label the same weight as a dominant one. This measures how many recorded categories persist under each mowing schedule. | Hill (1973), Nguyen & Liebman (2022) |
| Inverse Simpson diversity, \(D_2=1/\sum p_i^2\) | Squaring biomass shares emphasizes dominant weeds. The reciprocal gives the effective number of equally abundant categories that would produce the observed concentration. | Hill (1973) |
| Simpson evenness, \(E=D_2/S\) | Expresses effective diversity relative to the observed number of categories. It measures how evenly the mass is distributed and equals one when all positive-mass categories have equal shares. | Tuomisto (2012) |

With zero included weed mass, richness is zero and the other two indices are undefined. Each experimental plot contributes one mean per stratum (Hurlbert, 1984). Its richness mean uses every sampled quadrat. Its diversity and evenness means use quadrats with positive included mass.

```{r quadrat-roster}
samples <- distinct(
  clean, Sample_ID, Block, Treatment, Quadrat, Location, Stratum,
  Area_m2, Cutting_height_cm, Collection_date
)

expected <- bind_rows(
  expand_grid(
    Block = paste0("B", 1:4), Treatment = "T1",
    Stratum = "Cover_crop", Quadrat = 1:4
  ),
  expand_grid(
    Block = paste0("B", 1:4), Treatment = paste0("T", 2:4),
    Stratum = c("Broccoli", "Cover_crop"), Quadrat = 1:2
  )
)

keys <- c("Block", "Treatment", "Stratum", "Quadrat")

stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(samples$Sample_ID),
  nrow(anti_join(expected, samples, by = keys)) == 0L,
  nrow(anti_join(samples, expected, by = keys)) == 0L
)

write_csv(samples, "Sample_metadata.csv")
```

```{r category-quadrats}
observed_mass <- clean %>%
  group_by(Sample_ID, Broad_category) %>%
  summarise(Biomass_g = sum(Biomass_g), .groups = "drop")

category_quadrats <- expand_grid(
  Sample_ID = samples$Sample_ID,
  Broad_category = c("Volunteer", "Weed", "Cover crop")
) %>%
  left_join(observed_mass, by = c("Sample_ID", "Broad_category")) %>%
  left_join(samples, by = "Sample_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    Biomass_g = coalesce(Biomass_g, 0),
    Biomass_g_m2 = Biomass_g / Area_m2
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(category_quadrats) == 192L,
  near(sum(category_quadrats$Biomass_g), sum(clean$Biomass_g))
)

write_csv(category_quadrats, "Category_biomass_by_quadrat.csv")
```

```{r category-plot-means}
category_plots <- category_quadrats %>%
  group_by(Block, Treatment, Stratum, Broad_category) %>%
  summarise(
    N_quadrats = n(),
    Mean_quadrat_biomass_g = mean(Biomass_g),
    Mean_biomass_g_m2 = mean(Biomass_g_m2),

  )

se <- function(x) sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))

category_treatments <- category_plots %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Stratum, Broad_category) %>%
  summarise(
    N_plots = n(),
    SD_quadrat_biomass_g = sd(Mean_quadrat_biomass_g),
    SE_quadrat_biomass_g = se(Mean_quadrat_biomass_g),
    SD_biomass_g_m2 = sd(Mean_biomass_g_m2),
    SE_biomass_g_m2 = se(Mean_biomass_g_m2),
    Mean_quadrat_biomass_g = mean(Mean_quadrat_biomass_g),
    Mean_biomass_g_m2 = mean(Mean_biomass_g_m2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(category_plots, "Category_biomass_plot_means.csv")
write_csv(category_treatments, "Category_biomass_treatment_summary.csv")
```

```{r weed-mass-by-code}
weed_species_mass <- clean %>%
  filter(Include_primary) %>%
  group_by(Sample_ID, Species) %>%
  summarise(Biomass_g = sum(Biomass_g), .groups = "drop")

identified <- unique(clean$Species[clean$Include_sensitivity])

sample_masses <- clean %>%
  group_by(Sample_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Recorded_mass_g = sum(Biomass_g),
    Total_weed_mass_g = sum(Biomass_g[Include_primary]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r quadrat-indices}
indices <- function(taxa, label) {
  totals <- taxa %>%
    filter(Biomass_g > 0) %>%
    group_by(Sample_ID) %>%
    summarise(
      Included_mass_g = sum(Biomass_g),
      Richness = n(),
      Inverse_Simpson = 1 / sum((Biomass_g / sum(Biomass_g))^2),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  samples %>%
    left_join(sample_masses, by = "Sample_ID") %>%
    left_join(totals, by = "Sample_ID") %>%
    mutate(
      Analysis = label,
      Richness = coalesce(Richness, 0L),
      Included_mass_g = coalesce(Included_mass_g, 0),
      Simpson_evenness = Inverse_Simpson / na_if(Richness, 0L),
      Omitted_fraction_of_total_weed_mass =
        1 - Included_mass_g / na_if(Total_weed_mass_g, 0)
    )
}

quadrats <- bind_rows(
  indices(weed_species_mass, "Total weeds"),
  indices(
    filter(weed_species_mass, Species %in% identified),
    "Identified weed codes"
  )
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(quadrats) == 128L,
  all(is.na(quadrats$Inverse_Simpson) == (quadrats$Richness == 0L))
)

write_csv(quadrats, "Quadrat_indices.csv")
```

```{r plot-mean-indices}
metrics <- c("Richness", "Inverse_Simpson", "Simpson_evenness")

defined_mean <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

plot_means <- quadrats %>%
  group_by(Analysis, Block, Treatment, Stratum) %>%
  summarise(
    N_quadrats = n(),
    N_defined_diversity = sum(!is.na(Inverse_Simpson)),
    across(all_of(metrics), defined_mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(plot_means) == 56L,
  all(plot_means$N_quadrats == ifelse(plot_means$Treatment == "T1", 4, 2))
)

write_csv(plot_means, "Plot_mean_indices.csv")
show_table(filter(plot_means, Analysis == "Total weeds"))
```

## Biomass by broad category

A category absent from a sampled quadrat contributes zero recorded mass. Treatment summaries average quadrats within each plot, then give the four blocks equal weight. Broccoli rows and living-mulch strips are summarized separately.

```{r category-biomass-results}
show_table(select(
  category_treatments, Stratum, Treatment, Broad_category, N_plots,
  Mean_quadrat_biomass_g, Mean_biomass_g_m2, SE_biomass_g_m2
))
```

## Weed community composition at harvest

Stacked bars show the contribution of each weed group to mean dry biomass. The figures use the same colours and legend. The display cutoffs keep the legend readable. All recorded weed labels enter the primary indices. The six highest-biomass identified codes in the interrow and control comparison and the three highest in broccoli rows are labelled individually. Rankings give equal weight to each treatment within its sampling stratum. Remaining identified weeds and unidentified groups are shown separately.

```{r composition-quadrats}
species_grid <- expand.grid(
  Sample_ID = samples$Sample_ID,
  Species = sort(unique(weed_species_mass$Species)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

sp_quadrats <- merge(
  species_grid, weed_species_mass,
  by = c("Sample_ID", "Species"), all.x = TRUE
)
sp_quadrats$Biomass_g[is.na(sp_quadrats$Biomass_g)] <- 0

sp_quadrats <- merge(
  sp_quadrats,
  samples[c("Sample_ID", "Block", "Treatment", "Stratum", "Area_m2")],
  by = "Sample_ID"
)
sp_quadrats$Biomass_g_m2 <- sp_quadrats$Biomass_g / sp_quadrats$Area_m2

stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
  sum(sp_quadrats$Biomass_g), sum(weed_species_mass$Biomass_g)
)))

write_csv(sp_quadrats, "Species_composition_quadrats.csv")
```

```{r composition-plot-and-treatment-means}
sp_plots <- aggregate(
  Biomass_g_m2 ~ Block + Treatment + Stratum + Species,
  sp_quadrats, mean
)

sp_means <- aggregate(
  Biomass_g_m2 ~ Treatment + Stratum + Species,
  sp_plots, mean
)
names(sp_means)[names(sp_means) == "Biomass_g_m2"] <- "Mean_biomass_g_m2"

write_csv(sp_plots, "Species_composition_plot_means.csv")
write_csv(sp_means, "Species_composition_all_taxa.csv")
```

```{r composition-display-groups}
rank_species <- function(stratum, n_keep) {
  d <- subset(sp_means, Stratum == stratum & !grepl("^UNKNOWN", Species))
  ranking <- aggregate(Mean_biomass_g_m2 ~ Species, d, mean)
  index <- order(-ranking$Mean_biomass_g_m2, ranking$Species)
  head(as.character(ranking$Species[index]), n_keep)
}

sp_keep <- union(rank_species("Cover_crop", 6), rank_species("Broccoli", 3))

sp_means$Display_group <- with(
  sp_means,
  ifelse(
    grepl("^UNKNOWN", Species), "Unknown weeds",
    ifelse(Species %in% sp_keep, as.character(Species), "Other weeds")
  )
)

sp_display <- aggregate(
  Mean_biomass_g_m2 ~ Treatment + Stratum + Display_group,
  sp_means, sum
)
sp_totals <- aggregate(
  Mean_biomass_g_m2 ~ Treatment + Stratum,
  sp_means, sum
)

write_csv(sp_display, "Species_composition_display_groups.csv")
write_csv(sp_totals, "Species_composition_total_weeds.csv")
```

```{r composition-legend}
sp_levels <- c(sp_keep, "Unknown weeds", "Other weeds")
sp_display$Display_group <- factor(sp_display$Display_group, levels = sp_levels)

sp_colors <- c(
  SETPU = "#E76F61", DIGIS = "#55AEB3", ARTVU = "#B99535",
  ECHCG = "#7AA65A", CHEAL = "#6693CE", MALNE = "#AD83BA",
  AMARE = "#D96C9D", "Unknown weeds" = "#C4C4C4", "Other weeds" = "#666666"
)

extra <- setdiff(sp_keep, names(sp_colors))
if (length(extra)) {
  sp_colors <- c(
    sp_colors,
    setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(length(extra), "Dark 3"), extra)
  )
}

common_names <- c(
  SETPU = "Yellow foxtail", DIGIS = "Smooth crabgrass",
  ARTVU = "Common mugwort", ECHCG = "Barnyard grass",
  CHEAL = "Common lambsquarters", MALNE = "Common mallow",
  AMARE = "Redroot pigweed"
)

sp_labels <- setNames(sp_levels, sp_levels)
named <- intersect(sp_keep, names(common_names))
sp_labels[named] <- sprintf("%s (%s)", common_names[named], named)
```

```{r composition-plot-function}
make_species_plot <- function(stratum, subtitle) {
  d <- subset(sp_display, Stratum == stratum)
  totals <- subset(sp_totals, Stratum == stratum)

  ggplot(d, aes(Treatment, Mean_biomass_g_m2, fill = Display_group)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.62) +
    geom_text(
      data = totals, inherit.aes = FALSE,
      aes(Treatment, Mean_biomass_g_m2, label = sprintf("%.1f", Mean_biomass_g_m2)),
      vjust = -0.5, family = "serif", size = 4
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = sp_colors, limits = sp_levels, labels = sp_labels, drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)) +
    labs(
      title = "Weed community composition at broccoli harvest",
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Treatment",
      y = expression(Mean~weed~dry~biomass~(g~m^{-2})),
      fill = NULL,
      caption = "Labels give total weed biomass. Bars show means of four plots."
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = "serif") +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
    )
}
```

## Mowing effects on weed diversity

The primary comparison uses the three planted mowing treatments. T2 was mown one week before transplanting and at weeks 3 and 6 afterward. T3 was mown one week before and at week 6 afterward. T4 was mown one week before transplanting. The secondary interrow comparison includes the unplanted weedy control (T1).

### Statistical choices and their rationale

| Choice | Rationale in this experiment | Reference |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Response and unit | The response is the mean quadrat index of a plot. Each of the four blocks contributes one plot per treatment. This gives each randomized plot equal weight, including T1 plots with four quadrats. | Hurlbert (1984) |
| Sampling stratum | Intrarow and interrow samples differ in quadrat area and cutting height. Separate models compare treatments measured with the same protocol. | 2026 field sampling design |
| Model | Fit each index on its original scale as `index ~ Block + Treatment`. The fixed block term accounts for differences among the four field blocks. One plot per block–treatment cell supports an additive model. Collection date is determined by block. | NIST, *Randomized block designs* |
| Primary test statistic | The treatment F statistic compares between-treatment variation with residual variation after accounting for block. It tests for differences in any direction. | NIST, *Randomized block designs* |
| Randomization and exact p value | Conditional on the T1 position, permute the three planted treatment labels only within their own block. Enumerate all \((3!)^4=1,296\) assignments. The exact p value is the fraction with F at least as large as observed under the sharp null of no plot-level treatment effect. | Anderson & ter Braak (2003) |
| Multiple tests | Three indices in two strata give six primary tests. Report raw and Benjamini–Hochberg (BH) adjusted p values for this family. The identified-code sensitivity analysis and the three secondary tests each form a separate family. | Benjamini & Hochberg (1995) |
| Means and contrasts | Equal block weights estimate mean treatment responses across the four blocks. Pointwise 95% intervals describe uncertainty in each mean. Tukey adjustment covers all pairwise contrasts within one index and stratum. | Lenth (2016), Tukey (1949) |
| Diagnostics | Residual-versus-fitted plots assess spread. Normal Q–Q plots and Shapiro–Wilk W assess residual shape. Cook's distance flags influential plots for inspection. | Shapiro & Wilk (1965), Cook (1977) |

```{r enumerate-assignments}
orders <- rbind(
  c(1, 2, 3), c(1, 3, 2), c(2, 1, 3),
  c(2, 3, 1), c(3, 1, 2), c(3, 2, 1)
)
assignments <- as.matrix(expand.grid(rep(list(seq_len(nrow(orders))), 4)))
stopifnot(nrow(assignments) == 1296L)
```

```{r exact-block-test}
exact_rcbd <- function(y) {
  stopifnot(identical(dim(y), c(4L, 3L)), all(is.finite(y)))

  centered <- sweep(y, 1, rowMeans(y))
  total_ss <- sum(centered^2)
  if (total_ss == 0) {
    stop("No within-block variation for the randomization test.")
  }

  # Treatment SS and F have the same ordering when block totals are fixed.
  observed <- sum(colSums(centered)^2) / nrow(y)
  sums <- matrix(0, nrow(assignments), ncol(y))

  for (b in seq_len(nrow(y))) {
    permuted <- matrix(centered[b, ][orders], nrow = nrow(orders))
    sums <- sums + permuted[assignments[, b], , drop = FALSE]
  }

  permuted_ss <- rowSums(sums^2) / nrow(y)
  tolerance <- 64 * .Machine$double.eps * total_ss
  mean(permuted_ss >= observed - tolerance)
}
```

```{r model-inputs}
select_plots <- function(analysis, stratum, treatments) {
  d <- plot_means[
    plot_means$Analysis == analysis &
      plot_means$Stratum == stratum &
      plot_means$Treatment %in% treatments,
  ]

  d$Treatment <- factor(d$Treatment, levels = treatments)
  d$Block <- factor(d$Block, levels = paste0("B", 1:4))

  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(d$Block),
    all(table(d$Block, d$Treatment) == 1L)
  )

  d[order(d$Block, d$Treatment), ]
}
```

```{r fit-one-index}
fit_index <- function(d, metric, use_exact) {
  if (any(!is.finite(d[[metric]]))) {
    stop(
      "A plot has an undefined ", metric, " in ", d$Stratum[1],
      " (", d$Analysis[1], "). Inspect Plot_mean_indices.csv."
    )
  }

  fit <- lm(
    reformulate(c("Block", "Treatment"), metric),
    data = d, na.action = na.fail
  )
  a <- anova(fit)
  y <- matrix(d[[metric]], nrow = nlevels(d$Block), byrow = TRUE)
  id <- data.frame(Analysis = d$Analysis[1], Stratum = d$Stratum[1], Metric = metric)

  tests <- cbind(
    id,
    N_plots = nrow(d),
    F = a["Treatment", "F value"],
    df1 = a["Treatment", "Df"],
    df2 = df.residual(fit),
    Parametric_p = a["Treatment", "Pr(>F)"],
    Exact_p = if (use_exact) exact_rcbd(y) else NA_real_,
    Permutations = if (use_exact) nrow(assignments) else NA_integer_
  )

  em <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ Treatment, weights = "equal")
  means <- as.data.frame(confint(em, level = 0.95, adjust = "none"))
  pairs_table <- as.data.frame(summary(
    pairs(em), infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95, adjust = "tukey"
  ))

  sh <- shapiro.test(residuals(fit))
  diagnostics <- cbind(
    id,
    Residual_SD = sigma(fit),
    Shapiro_W = unname(sh$statistic),
    Shapiro_p = sh$p.value,
    Max_Cooks_distance = max(cooks.distance(fit))
  )

  list(
    tests = tests,
    emmeans = cbind(means, id[rep(1L, nrow(means)), , drop = FALSE]),
    pairs = cbind(pairs_table, id[rep(1L, nrow(pairs_table)), , drop = FALSE]),
    diagnostics = diagnostics,
    model = fit
  )
}
```

```{r run-model-family}
run_family <- function(analysis, strata, treatments, use_exact) {
  fits <- list()

  for (s in strata) {
    d <- select_plots(analysis, s, treatments)
    for (m in metrics) {
      fits[[paste(s, m, sep = " / ")]] <- fit_index(d, m, use_exact)
    }
  }

  collect <- function(field) {
    x <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fits, "[[", field))
    rownames(x) <- NULL
    x
  }

  tests <- collect("tests")
  tests$Exact_p_BH <- if (use_exact) p.adjust(tests$Exact_p, "BH") else NA_real_
  tests$Parametric_p_BH <- p.adjust(tests$Parametric_p, "BH")

  list(
    tests = tests,
    emmeans = collect("emmeans"),
    pairs = collect("pairs"),
    diagnostics = collect("diagnostics"),
    models = lapply(fits, "[[", "model")
  )
}
```

```{r primary-models}
strata <- c("Cover_crop", "Broccoli")
planted <- c("T2", "T3", "T4")

primary <- run_family("Total weeds", strata, planted, TRUE)
show_table(primary$tests)
```

```{r primary-means-and-contrasts}
show_table(primary$emmeans)
show_table(primary$pairs)
```

### Sensitivity to unidentified weeds

The identified-code analysis repeats the six tests after removing unidentified weed groups. The quadrat table records the fraction of weed dry mass removed from each sample.

```{r sensitivity-models}
sensitivity <- run_family("Identified weed codes", strata, planted, TRUE)
show_table(sensitivity$tests)
```

### Secondary comparison with the weedy control

This exploratory comparison uses the 0.16 m² quadrats cut at 8 cm. Contrasts with T1 reflect planting and mowing together. T1 contributes four quadrats per plot and T2–T4 contribute two, so the precision of a plot mean can differ among treatments. This analysis reports the parametric treatment test.

```{r secondary-models}
secondary <- run_family("Total weeds", "Cover_crop", paste0("T", 1:4), FALSE)
show_table(secondary$tests)
show_table(secondary$emmeans)
show_table(secondary$pairs)
```

```{r export-model-tables, include=FALSE}
export_family <- function(x, prefix) {
  write_csv(x$tests, paste0(prefix, "_tests.csv"))
  write_csv(x$emmeans, paste0(prefix, "_emmeans.csv"))
  write_csv(x$pairs, paste0(prefix, "_Tukey_pairs.csv"))
}

export_family(primary, "Primary_T2_T4")
export_family(sensitivity, "Sensitivity_identified_codes_T2_T4")
export_family(secondary, "Secondary_T1_T4_Cover_crop")
write_csv(primary$diagnostics, "Primary_model_diagnostics.csv")
```

## Diversity by treatment

```{r diversity-figure-data}
d <- subset(plot_means, Analysis == "Total weeds")

long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(metrics, function(m) {
  data.frame(
    d[c("Block", "Treatment", "Stratum")],
    Metric = m,
    Value = d[[m]]
  )
}))

em <- rbind(
  secondary$emmeans,
  subset(primary$emmeans, Stratum == "Broccoli")
)

metric_labels <- c("Richness", "Inverse Simpson", "Simpson evenness")
long$Metric <- factor(long$Metric, levels = metrics, labels = metric_labels)
em$Metric <- factor(em$Metric, levels = metrics, labels = metric_labels)

stratum_labels <- c("Interrow and control", "Broccoli rows")
long$Stratum <- factor(long$Stratum, levels = strata, labels = stratum_labels)
em$Stratum <- factor(em$Stratum, levels = strata, labels = stratum_labels)
```

```{r diversity-figure, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
p <- ggplot(long, aes(Treatment, Value)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = Block),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.25),
    size = 2, colour = "grey45"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = em,
    aes(x = Treatment, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, width = 0.12
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = em, aes(Treatment, emmean),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 18, size = 3.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Stratum + Metric, ncol = 3, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Treatment", y = "Mean quadrat index",
    caption = paste(
      "Small symbols show plot means.",
      "Diamonds show adjusted means with pointwise 95% confidence intervals."
    )
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p)
```

## Model diagnostics

```{r diagnostic-table}
show_table(primary$diagnostics)
```

```{r diagnostic-figures, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
plot_diagnostics <- function(fit, title) {
  old <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
  on.exit(par(old))

  plot(
    fitted(fit), residuals(fit),
    xlab = "Fitted value", ylab = "Residual",
    main = title, pch = 19, cex.main = 0.85
  )
  abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

  qqnorm(residuals(fit), main = "Residual normal Q–Q", pch = 19)
  qqline(residuals(fit))
}

for (name in names(primary$models)) {
  plot_diagnostics(primary$models[[name]], name)
}
```

Inference concerns the 2026 harvest and the randomized plots. The adjacent plastic-mulched beds serve as a production benchmark outside the diversity analysis.
